title: load runtime extensions from bytes in memory
body:
Currently sqlite loads runtime extensions from disk.

In wasm32-unknown-unknown, we would need to be able to load them from bytes in memory.

Would this even be possible? An extension like cr-sqlite is like 2.2 MB
author: DougAnderson444

comments.body:
I don't think loading extensions works on wasm, there is no dlopen on this platform.

But if we assume it does, we can upload the extension to opfs and then load it with sqlite.
Hmm, ok. Do you know any way to bundle the extension into sqlite-wasm-rs at build time?

> Hmm, ok. Do you know any way to bundle the extension into sqlite-wasm-rs at build time?

I don't know much about this, but I think it can be done. It may be a challenge on `wasm32-unknown-unknown` because there is no `libc` for that platform, depending on the plugin implementation.
